init_dist_pytorch: initialize distributed training with pytorch launcher and nccl backend for multi-GPU setup
init_dist_slurm: initialize distributed training environment using slurm launcher with automatic master port detection
get_dist_info: get the current process rank and world size from the distributed training environment
master_only: decorate a function so it executes only on the master process with rank zero
allreduce_params: allreduce model parameters across all processes with optional coalescing and bucket size control
